distribution.summary: 福建；广东；广西；海南；江西；云南；香港；台湾
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) provides broad mainland, Hong Kong and Taiwan occurrence evidence. Beaver & Liu (2010) independently supports Taiwan, and Lau (2025) supports Hong Kong. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports Fujian, Guangdong, Guangxi, Hainan, Hong Kong, Jiangxi, Yunnan and Taiwan, matching the current reviewed distribution without changing it.

host_note: Current species-level hosts Cinnamomum camphora and Ligustrum lucidum are retained from Smith et al. (2020). Beaver & Liu (2010) provides broad polyphagy context but no Taiwan hosts. Smith et al. (2022) provides no host in the curated record, so the current host synthesis is unchanged.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Diuncus haberkorni (Eggers, 1920).

nomenclature_note: Canonical identity follows integrated taxonomic backbone: Diuncus haberkorni (Eggers, 1920), VSN_2393. Beaver & Liu (2010) synonymized Xyleborus taichuensis Schedl under Diuncus haberkorni after examination of type and comparative material; this synonymy is retained as nomenclatural provenance.
